annotations.title: Macro economic data: GDP, inflation, unemployment and population by country

description: Macro economic data for any country in one call: GDP in current US dollars, consumer-price inflation %, unemployment % of the labour force and total population, each with 1-10 years of history, newest first. Country by ISO code (SE, SWE) or English name. Read from a committed World Bank Open Data snapshot (CC BY 4.0), so every call answers quickly; the snapshot date is in the answer. Use for country briefs, market sizing and economic indicators. Example: country=SE. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
